listing.name: Marxon Portrait Pack
listing.summary: Adds portraits for multiple factions including Tri-Tachyon, Hegemony, Persean League, Mercenaries, Luddic Path, Sindrian Diktat, Independents, Pirates, and Player.
listing.aiSummary: Adds portraits for multiple factions including Tri-Tachyon, Hegemony, Persean League, Mercenaries, Luddic Path, Sindrian Diktat, Independents, Pirates, and Player.

description:
Welcome to my portrait pack.

Yet another pack to add to the dozens of ones that already exist.

I recently started playing Starsector again after a several year hiatus from the game. While playing I wanted to add more pirate portraits, but in the process of doing so wound up making some more for a few of the other factions.

This portrait pack adds in portraits for the Tri-Tachyon, Hegemony, Persean League, Mercenary, Pirate and Player factions.

1.0.1 added Luddic Path, Independent, and Sindrian Diktat Portraits.

1.0.2 added Tri-Tachyon, Sindrian Diktat, and Independent Portraits.

Tri-Tachyon:

11 Portraits

The Hegemony:

8 Portraits

Persean League:

4 Portraits

Mercenaries:

5 Portraits

Luddic Path:

3 Portraits

Sindrian Diktat:

6 Portraits

Independents:

7 Portraits

Pirates:

22 Portraits

Player:

3 Unique Portraits (All portraits are available to the player)

Disclaimer:

I used NovelAI to make these portraits and attempted to keep the style as close to the game as possible.

aiDescription: Adds a collection of portraits generated using NovelAI for various Starsector factions. The pack includes portraits for Tri-Tachyon, Hegemony, Persean League, Mercenaries, Luddic Path, Sindrian Diktat, Independents, Pirates, and Player characters. Updates have expanded the number of available portraits for each faction.
